mapper.sql: id, member_id, slug, title, payment_id, name, result_json, status, error, input_json, attempts, failed_at, started_at, deleted_at, expires_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fortune_results (member_id, slug, title, payment_id, name, status, input_json, attempts, started_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{slug}, #{title}, #{paymentId}, #{name}, #{status}, #{inputJson}, 0, now(), now() + INTERVAL '1 year') ON CONFLICT (payment_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE fortune_results SET result_json = NULL, input_json = NULL, name = NULL WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < #{now} AND result_json IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.slug, COALESCE(r.title, f.title) AS title, r.name, r.status, r.created_at, r.expires_at, p.status AS payment_status FROM fortune_results r LEFT JOIN fortunes f ON f.slug = r.slug LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id WHERE r.member_id = #{memberId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.member_id, r.slug, r.payment_id, r.name, r.result_json, r.status, r.error, r.input_json, r.attempts, r.failed_at, r.deleted_at, r.expires_at, r.created_at, p.status AS payment_status FROM fortune_results r LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.member_id = #{memberId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM fortune_results WHERE status = 'GENERATING' AND COALESCE(started_at, created_at) < #{before} ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE fortune_results SET result_json = NULL, input_json = NULL, name = NULL, deleted_at = COALESCE(deleted_at, #{now}) WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
